is: The one path consumers use into Zurfur's domain: it re-exports kernel, identity and workflow so every `domain::…` path resolves, and owns only the unit of work, which vends the write ports of kernel, identity and workflow.
conventions: Declarations only: the façade files hold module docs, the unit-of-work module and glob re-exports with a leading `::`.
No consumer crate depends on a domain crate other than `domain`; the guards in tests/it/ enforce it.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: kernel, identity, workflow, async-trait, anyhow; dev-deps serde_json, syn (with visit), quote and proc-macro2 for the guards

fs.name: README.md
fs.role: the façade and the domain crates: what each holds, the dependency rules, the guards

fs.name: src/
fs.role: the façade re-exports + the unit of work

fs.name: tests/
fs.role: it/ — the domain crates' one guard binary: elements_do_not_import_ports.rs (elements never depend on ports, in every domain crate), domain_crates_point_one_way.rs (allowed workspace dependencies per domain crate; consumers name only domain), facade_paths.rs (every re-exported path resolves), no_actor_port_takes_a_node_id.rs (no port of identity, nor of kernel but the node port, takes or returns a NodeId, through any renamed import or type alias in either crate; aliases read with syn, signatures from proc-macro2 tokens with macro bodies included; planted alias cases)

notes: The domain crates: kernel (the shared vocabulary), identity (who acts), workflow (the work), gallery and moderation (stubs), and this façade over them.
